svg.title: iOS · Stills import · the question · warned · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/StillsImportSheet.swift over AppModel.stillsImportQuestion — the question Create ▸ Import photos… asks once the pick has resolved to two or more files and before any copy: a shoot, or a photo each. The reading is ImportedStills.reading (Kit, ImportedStills+Reading.swift; docs/import-classification.md §3): a SHOOT is a clean set — one name sequence, every frame on one beat, the only irregularity a pause whose beat continues — and PHOTOS is suggested only when no beat of 24 frames exists anywhere. Title = the count; the line under it = the files' own reading (the one folder they came from · formats · body · first shutter to last). Two rows say what each answer MAKES, in numbers, so Photos on a 5030-file folder reads as the 5030 projects it would be. Import is the default action (⏎) and Cancel (⎋) is always reachable; the sheet is not dismissable by swipe or click-away — the import is suspended on a continuation inside runStillsImport, and an answer is what starts the copy. LL_IMPORT_STILLS=<folder> with no LL_IMPORT_ANSWER stages it; LL_IMPORT_ANSWER=shoot|photos|cancel answers it headless. THIS FILE: the warned state. The files disagree with each other, so NO row is pre-selected, Import is inert (45 % opacity) until one is chosen, and an amber line says why, naming the files — the fix is always one the person makes, in the folder or by choosing knowingly; the app never drops a file it merely copied. Drawn on /Volumes/letslapse/Source_SONY/Charles_ARW as it stands: 306 ARW frames on a 3.6 s beat plus _WEX3518-Rendered.dng, a Lightroom render of frame 3518 sitting beside its raw with the same capture time to the millisecond — a stranger by name (stem _WEX#-Rendered, 3518 twice), which the old import took as a 307th frame. The line adds what the folder becomes without it. The other lines this box carries, one per reading: strangers by beat (test shots 30–60 s apart before the run, a snap taken mid-run — named, never imported silently), strangers by clock, RAW+JPEG pairs, a beat change, a slow beat (> 60 s), a short sequence (< 24 frames), no capture times, irregular names. Verified 2026-09-15 against the running app on this folder. On the phone the sheet is full height like the archive sheet — its 380-wide content sits centred in the 393-pt screen with the two buttons anchored at the bottom above the home indicator, and the space between the rows and the buttons is the sheet's, not a control. iPad shares this file (a form sheet). Verified 2026-09-15 on an iPhone 16 Pro simulator (LetsLapse Fresh device, LL_IMPORT_STILLS).

g.text: One project of 307 frames, 3.6 s apart
306 frames keep a 3.6 s beat. 1 file doesn't
this folder is a shoot — move it out and import
